verdict.rationale: Proration is a fair question for an invoicing and recurring-billing product, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only recurring invoices and manually created credit notes. Nothing shows mid-cycle upgrade or downgrade proration, partial-period calculation, or documented proration math, so credit notes are an adjacent feature at most.

support.subject: As a finance lead, mid-cycle upgrades and downgrades are prorated with documented, auditable math — credits, partial periods, and invoice line items that reconcile to the penny
